title: SIFMA-recommended US fixed-income early close, 2:00 p.m. ET — the one hour a year when the bond tape outlives the equity tape, and the last legal Fed voice before the December blackout
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule ('Holiday Schedule', SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) and parsed out of the page's embedded RSC payload by this session, because the 2027 panel is a tab whose text the rendered page drops. The US 2027 Thanksgiving entry renders as three fields: heading 'Thanksgiving Day', date 'Thursday, November 25, 2027', note 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, November 26, 2027'. PANEL ATTRIBUTION WAS VERIFIED RATHER THAN ASSUMED, which is the step the sibling proposal thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26.from-fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27 recorded itself unable to take: the payload carries three 2027 panels in sequence and this entry sits inside the US-only run (U.S. Independence Day / Labor Day / Columbus Day / Veterans Day / Thanksgiving Day / Christmas Day, with US early-close notes), while the UK panel that follows carries 'Spring Bank Holiday' and 'Summer Bank Holiday' and no early-close notes, and the Japan panel after it carries 'Coming-of-Age Day', 'Labour Thanksgiving Day' and a 'Tentative - Subject to confirmation by the Bank of Japan' note on every card. The attribution was then cross-validated against a card this repo already records verbatim: sifma-bond-early-close-2027-05-28's source quotes 'Memorial Day' / 'Monday, May 31, 2027' / 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, May 28, 2027', and this session's parse of the same panel returns exactly that string. The full 2027 US early-close list this parse returns is Thu 2027-03-25, Fri 2027-05-28, Fri 2027-07-02, Fri 2027-11-26, Thu 2027-12-23, Fri 2027-12-31 — with Presidents Day and MLK 2027 carrying no note, the negative control. Filed estimate on the same three counts as every sibling SIFMA entry: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA states its closes are recommendations subject to change rather than a market-wide halt. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-08), at D+1 inside that event's +/-5-day corridor. It reuses the sifma-bond-early-close-<date> class exactly (2026-12-31, 2027-03-25, 2027-05-28 are already on this calendar) and invents no new kind. WHY IT IS A SEPARATE ROW FROM THE EQUITY HALF DAY, which is proposed independently as thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26: the two markets close at DIFFERENT TIMES on this session and in the unusual direction. NYSE footnote *** (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, re-read HTTP 200 the same session) puts equities out at 13:00 ET and eligible options at 13:15; SIFMA recommends fixed income out at 14:00 ET. So from 13:00 to 14:00 ET the US Treasury tape is the only US price discovery still running, and any cross-asset leg loses its EQUITY reference first. That is the inverse of the ordinary early close and the inverse of good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, where equities outlive bonds; the sibling ledger thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 records the identical one-hour split for the 2026 instance, so 2027 is the second observation of the shape rather than a novelty. SECOND REASON IT EARNS A ROW: it is the DEADLINE SESSION of the December 2027 FOMC blackout. The gate opens 12:00 a.m. ET Saturday 2027-11-27 (fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27, estimate, for a 2027-12-07/08 meeting federalreserve.gov itself calls tentative), so the last on-record monetary-policy remark before the year's final meeting must land inside a three-and-a-half-hour equity session whose bond leg runs one hour longer. WHAT THIS PROPOSAL DELIBERATELY DOES NOT CLAIM. It asserts nothing about the equity half day's own behaviour — that is the half-day entry's subject, and the discovering ledger's measured finding is that the repricing across the Thanksgiving closure lands on the MONDAY rather than on this Friday (session 2 out-moves session 1 in 35 of 56 years against 42.8% pooled across the Monday closures, p = 0.0092). It asserts nothing about CME rate-futures hours: cmegroup.com has 403'd this runner in every sibling lane and was not re-attempted. IMPACT low, symbols [] — a recommended early close is a market-structure fact that changes how a session is READ, never a signal. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
